svg.title: Blue Relief with Black
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry and interpretive screen colours. The black backing rectangle is painted support and remains; blue curved overlay and depth are simplified. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for black, blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.glenstone.org/artworks/blue-relief-with-black; inspected2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation, not a facsimile.
